name: ORB with 5-minute EMA
verdict: Replacing ORB's hold-to-close exit with 12-EMA exits weakens it at every stop width and cost case; 15-minute EMA exits are better than 5-minute but still trail ORB.
description: Original 5-minute EMA entry/exit experiments across stop widths and cost cases. Earlier assumptions are preserved; see the separate Tiered/1c follow-up for the later cost convention.
